Priya (PartnerEng): quick FYI — Snowflake asked for explicit per-tenant SLA language and a quota model for our connector listing. can we sync?
Diego (Eng): ETA on what they need exactly?
Priya (PartnerEng): they want 99.9% availability for connector control-plane, and a soft quota system for ingest tokens per customer with graceful throttling + backoff docs.
Alex M. (Product): 99.9% control-plane SLA is fine for hosted customers but dedicated/private gets different constraints. we'll need opt-in tiers.
Jordan (Legal): Heads-up: legal will need specific liability and data residency callouts. also need to avoid hard uptime promises for customer-managed installs.
Sam P. (Field): Field feedback: customers will push back if quotas are too aggressive. we should include an overage/burst policy and clear contact path for support escalation.
Diego (Eng): technically we can emit a per-tenant telemetry flag and expose a /quota endpoint in the connector sidecar. low effort: add rate-limited token bucket and 429 responses with Retry-After.
Priya (PartnerEng): perfect — can you sketch the API surface? partner review tomorrow at 10am PST.
Diego (Eng): stub below:```json
{ "GET /v1/tenant/{id}/quota": { "allowed": 12345, "used": 2345, "reset": "2025-05-01T00:00:00Z" }, "POST /v1/tenant/{id}/ingest": { "429": { "message": "quota exceeded", "retry_after": 30 } } }
```
Alex M. (Product): add a header X-Connector-Plan to responses so marketplace can show plan/limits in UI.
Jordan (Legal): also require a customer opt-in checkbox for data sharing/telemetry in Private deployments. provide a minimal OSS-style config block for air-gapped installs.
Sam P. (Field): example config snippet please, customers ask for it in proofs:
Diego (Eng):```
# connector.conf
telemetry.enabled=false
quota.enforce=true
quota.plan=standard
quota.burst=50
```
Priya (PartnerEng): thanks — I'll assemble a short doc for Snowflake: SLA text, quota model, telemetry opt-in, and escalation matrix.
partners-bot: Reminder: meeting "Snowflake connector SLA review" scheduled @ 2025-05-02 18:00 UTC
Alex M. (Product): quick product note — we should include recommended defaults: standard = 1k tokens/sec, burst 50, overage route to dedicated capacity.
Sam P. (Field): agree. i'll draft a customer-facing FAQ about quotas and how to request higher tiers.
Jordan (Legal): I'll draft limited warranty language and share redlines by EOD.
Priya (PartnerEng): great. action items: Diego to PR quota endpoints by EOD today, Jordan to share legal redlines, Alex to add header spec, Sam to draft FAQ, Priya to compile doc for Snowflake. meeting tomorrow to finalize. :thumbsup:
